steps: Step 1: Blood from the body enters the right atrium.
Step 2: It passes down into the right ventricle.
Step 3: The right ventricle pumps it to the lungs.
Step 4: Blood from the lungs returns to the left atrium.
Step 5: It passes into the left ventricle.
Step 6: The left ventricle pumps it to the body.
alt.summary: A schematic front view of the heart: two upper chambers, two lower chambers, the septum between the sides, and the main vessels above.

parts.function: Brings deoxygenated blood from the body to the right atrium.
parts.name: Vena cava

parts.function: Carries blood from the right ventricle to the lungs.
parts.name: Pulmonary artery

parts.function: Collects blood from the body and passes it to the right ventricle.
parts.name: Right atrium

parts.function: The wall that keeps blood in the two sides apart.
parts.name: Septum

parts.function: Carries blood from the left ventricle to the body.
parts.name: Aorta

parts.function: Brings oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium.
parts.name: Pulmonary vein

parts.function: Collects blood from the lungs and passes it to the left ventricle.
parts.name: Left atrium

parts.function: Pumps oxygenated blood to the whole body, so its wall is the thickest.
parts.name: Left ventricle
